layering: role score = mean over the role's players
series score = sum of the best two games
TI exposure = expectation over the number of series played
method.where_the_bonus_is_applied: the player-game, before role averaging, so a bonus that correlates with how the game went is priced with that correlation intact
method.paired_comparison: common random numbers across coach settings, so a reported gain is a paired difference and not the difference of two noisy means
method.why_not_frequency_times_bonus: the period keeps a maximum, so a trigger that fires on games the maximum discards is worth far less than its frequency, and one that fires on the best games is worth more. The measured attenuation on prefixes we can score exactly ranges from 0.06 to 1.8, so the naive product is not even reliable to within an order of magnitude.

withdrawn_claim.claim: the community frequencies admit two equally admissible readings, a percentage reading and a normalised-count reading, and the recommendation is ROBUST across both
withdrawn_claim.why: the second reading divides a value by the sum of the eight categories, which is not a denominator: the categories overlap, and a player's eight values routinely sum past 100. The source uses the values as percentage frequencies, and our own hero data reproduces them player by player, so there is one reading, not two.
withdrawn_claim.replaced_by: frequency_replication, which tests the percentage reading against our own independently fetched hero table

the Tormented.verdict: RULED OUT: the upper bound on its trigger rate is below the rate it would need even under the most favourable attenuation measured

the Cruel.why: the condition is positional -- a death at a team's own fountain -- and no field in the match object carries a death position. killed_by names the killer, not the place. Recovering it needs full replay parsing, not an API field.
the Cruel.direction_of_the_error: a fountain death happens in games that are being lost badly, so its attenuation belongs at the LOW end of the measured range, which is where its breakpoint is least achievable
